name: Conan Exiles
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Open-world survival in the lands of Conan the Barbarian. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with Workshop mods if you want them.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./ConanSandbox/Binaries/Linux/ConanSandboxServer-Linux-Shipping -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -RconPort={{RCON_PORT}} -MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -ServerName="{{SRV_NAME}}" ${SRV_PW:+-ServerPassword="$SRV_PW"} -MULTIHOME=0.0.0.0 -console -log

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Conan Exiles. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 443030) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and Workshop mods when asked. Saves,
# configs and your own mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-443030}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The settings the Panel writes at every start need their sections; the
# rest of each file is the owner's.
cfg=ConanSandbox/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
mkdir -p "$cfg" ConanSandbox/Mods
grep -qs '^\[ServerSettings\]' "$cfg/ServerSettings.ini" || printf '[ServerSettings]\nAdminPassword=\n' >> "$cfg/ServerSettings.ini"
grep -qs '^\[RconPlugin\]' "$cfg/Game.ini" || printf '[RconPlugin]\nRconEnabled=0\nRconPassword=\nRconPort=25575\n' >> "$cfg/Game.ini"
touch ConanSandbox/Mods/modlist.txt

# Workshop mods: downloaded anonymously, linked into ConanSandbox/Mods and
# listed first in modlist.txt, in the order given. Mods you put in
# ConanSandbox/Mods yourself stay listed after them.
ids=$(tr ', ' '\n\n' <<<"${MOD_IDS:-}" | grep -v '^$' || true)
list=ConanSandbox/Mods/modlist.txt
keep=$(grep -vE '^\*[0-9]+/' "$list" || true)
: > "$list.new"
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then
    wargs=()
    for id in $ids; do
        [[ "$id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "Mod IDs has \"$id\", which isn't a Workshop ID. Use the numbers from the mods' Workshop links, separated by commas."
        wargs+=(+workshop_download_item 440900 "$id")
    done
    echo "Downloading $(wc -w <<<"$ids") Workshop mods"
    for try in 1 2 3; do
        ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous "${wargs[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
        missing=""
        for id in $ids; do ls steamapps/workshop/content/440900/"$id"/*.pak >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing $id"; done
        [ -z "$missing" ] && break
        [ "$try" = 3 ] && fail "Steam didn't give these Workshop mods:$missing. Check they're Conan Exiles mods and public, then reinstall."
        sleep 5
    done
    for id in $ids; do
        ln -sfn "../../steamapps/workshop/content/440900/$id" "ConanSandbox/Mods/$id"
        for pak in steamapps/workshop/content/440900/"$id"/*.pak; do echo "*$id/${pak##*/}" >> "$list.new"; done
    done
fi
# Links of mods taken off the list go; the downloads stay in steamapps.
for link in ConanSandbox/Mods/*; do
    [ -L "$link" ] || continue
    grep -qx "${link##*/}" <<<"$ids" || rm -f "$link"
done
[ -z "$keep" ] || echo "$keep" >> "$list.new"
mv "$list.new" "$list"
n=$(wc -w <<<"$ids")
mods="$n Workshop mod"; [ "$n" = 1 ] || mods+=s
echo "Installed Conan Exiles build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}${MOD_IDS:+ with $mods}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password that makes a player an admin in game, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Mod IDs
variables.description: Workshop IDs of the mods to load, separated by commas, in load order. Reinstall after changing them.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: Turn on remote admin over RCON.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port RCON listens on; give it an allocation if you use it.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
